title: Awe
summary: AWE, noun aw. [Gr. to be astonished.] 1. Fear mingled with admiration or reverence; reverential fear. Stand in awe and sin not. Psalms 4:4. 2. Fear; dread inspired by something great, or terrific. AWE

inlines.v: AWE, noun aw. [Gr. to be astonished.] 1. Fear mingled with admiration or reverence; reverential fear. Stand in awe and sin not. Psalms 4:4. 2. Fear; dread inspired by something great, or terrific. AWE, verb transitive To strike with fear and reverence; to influence by fear, terror or respect; as, his majesty awed them into silence.
